name: Wikistory: The Lost Fragments
summary: Wikistory: The Lost Fragments is a free-to-play TCG that runs directly in your web browser, on both desktop and mobile devices. Each booster pack pulls content from actual Wikipedia articles and transforms it into cards, known as "fragments"—with the artwork, text, type, and statistics all derived from the original article. The more frequently an article is read, the rarer its corresponding card becomes. Discover unique variants and cards—such as HOLO, GOLD, PARALLEL, CYBER, and MISSPRINT—along with numbered series, culminating in the NEBULA: a one-of-a-kind, singular fragment.
